rows.author: C017
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING THE USE OF ENGLISH AS THE MEDIUM OF INSTRUCTION IN PHILIPPINE SCHOOLS
rows.title_short: \"English as the Medium of Instruction Act.\"
rows.abstract: \"English as the Medium of Instruction Act\". The bill mandates the use of English as the medium of instruction in all subjects taught in the elementary and secondary levels except in preschool and until Grade I where, aside from English, the regional or native tongue may be used. It also provides for the use of English as the medium of instruction in all subjects in the tertiary level and technical or vocational courses except in Pilipino taught as a subject.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-09-19, transmitted to on 2006-09-26 and received by the Senate on 2006-09-26

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HALON BANK FACILITY IN THE PHILIPPINES AND APPORPRIATING THE AMOUNT OF TWENTY MILLION (P20,000,000.00) PESOS FOR THE PURPOSE
rows.abstract: The measure provides for the establishment of a halon bank facility which shall develop and implement comprehensive strategies to manage existing stocks of halon (ozone-depleting substances) down to zero, advise on the disposal of halons and assist in locating halons in the country.
